name: Aqua's Utils
description: Toolbox plugin: surfaces compatible extension errors, launches a self-contained solver (or connects to a remote one you run) to reach guarded sites, and more.
author: aquaryuo

networkAccess.reasoning: Reads the local Seanime log API (loopback) to collect reported extension errors; talks to a local or user-configured remote solver to manage sessions; downloads the aquatils-solver release from GitHub for the self-contained binary mode and, when the Chromium download is on, a Chromium from Google's Chrome for Testing. Any domain is requested because Remote mode lets you point the plugin at a solver on a host only you know; in the default Binary mode the only hosts contacted are loopback, github.com and its release-asset host, the Chrome-for-Testing index (googlechromelabs.github.io) and its download bucket (storage.googleapis.com).

commandScopes.description: Linux/macOS (Binary mode): start the downloaded aquatils-solver and prepare the downloaded Chromium (chmod, and clear the macOS quarantine flag on both); hash the download before it runs (sha256sum/shasum); unpack Chromium on macOS (ditto); check Chromium's system libraries (Xvfb, ldd, dpkg-query, whether apt-get exists) and look for an installed Chromium; install missing packages with apt-get as root or passwordless sudo, only when you press Install; stop this plugin's own solver and Chromium processes (pkill/kill, matched on an aquatils folder in their path) and wait for the solver port to close (ss/lsof).

Windows (Binary mode): start the downloaded aquatils-solver from its own folder; hash the download with certutil before it runs; stop this plugin's own leftover solver and Chromium processes via PowerShell, matched on an aquatils folder in their path.
